description: Follow Maine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Maine Democrats scramble to select replacement for Platner in Senate race
changes.summary: Democrats now have a process for choosing a replacement for Senate candidate Graham Platner. But voters are still reeling from his fall.

changes.title: Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows on her bid to replace Platner in Senate race
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows about her run to replace Graham Platner in the Maine Senate race.

changes.title: Maine Democrats to Chuck Schumer: Stay Out of Our Senate Race
changes.summary: Local Democrats are warning the top Senate Democrat to keep away as they replace Graham Platner, and the candidates are giving his leadership in Washington low marks.

changes.title: 1 person killed in Maine shooting involving ICE, state House speaker says
changes.summary: A person was killed during a shooting in Maine involving U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement on Monday morning, state House Speaker Ryan Fecteau said.

changes.title: Maine Democrats Will Replace Graham Platner. Here’s What to Know.
changes.summary: Mr. Platner’s withdrawal from a marquee Senate race, under pressure from his party, has set in motion an unusual competition to become the new nominee.

changes.title: Ro Khanna says he regrets his endorsement of Graham Platner: ‘I got that call wrong’
changes.summary: Rep. Ro Khanna (D-Calif.) joins Meet the Press for an exclusive interview after Graham Platner (D) exits the Maine Senate race amid a sexual assault allegation.

changes.title: Platner’s Rise and Fall Revives Old Questions About ‘Bernie Bros’ and Women
changes.summary: The collapse of Graham Platner’s Senate bid in Maine after a rape allegation renewed attention to a movement built by Senator Bernie Sanders that some say is too forgiving of male misconduct.

changes.title: How The Times Reported on Graham Platner
changes.summary: Two senior editors discuss the difficult effort to track down allegations against the leading Democrat for Senate in Maine and the questions that soon followed.

changes.title: Graham Platner officially withdraws from the Maine Senate race
changes.summary: Democrats have already set off a mad dash to find a new candidate, with a July 27 deadline to submit a replacement nominee to face Republican Sen. Susan Collins in the November election.
